environment.description: Deployed on ECS Fargate behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The PostgreSQL RDS instance uses the 'pipeline_svc' database user which has full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on the pipeline_db schema. The service is accessible to any authenticated developer via the internal network. No output encoding or CSP headers are configured on the load balancer or application.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO pipeline_svc
config.network: internal VPC, accessible to all developer workstations
